experimental_ddG_basis: TTBK1 330 nM vs TTBK2 490 nM, both single values from one assay in Nozal 2022 (PMID 34978799). The paper publishes no error on either, so the +/- is an ASSUMED 30% within-assay IC50 precision propagated through the log, not a measured uncertainty.
